summary: @or-sdk/providers preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB sibling bundle
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated `@bun-cjs` bundle with a shuffled string/opcode array and rotation decoder. Both `setup.mjs` (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifiers and property-alias tables) and `math_init.js` are obfuscated. The package advertises itself as an SDK providers module; fetching a second language runtime at install specifically to execute an opaque 700KB blob is not a build or SDK requirement and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to bypass Node-focused scanners. The Bun binary is fetched from its official project domain, but the code executed under it is author-controlled obfuscated content shipped in the tarball, giving the author arbitrary code execution on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
